steps.code:
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
步骤 1/3：清洗模拟订单明细 -> clean.csv
注意：以下数据为【模拟数据】，仅用于流程演示，不代表任何公司真实经营情况。
"""
import io
import pandas as pd

# 中文字体（本机可用 Microsoft YaHei / SimHei）
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.rcParams['font.sans-serif'] = ['Microsoft YaHei', 'SimHei', 'DejaVu Sans']
plt.rcParams['axes.unicode_minus'] = False

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 输入：模拟订单明细（内嵌，无外部依赖，不联网）
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
RAW_CSV = """order_id,month,revenue,cost
A01,2026-01,1200,720
A02,2026-01,800,560
A03,2026-01,1500,900
A03,2026-01,1500,900
B01,2026-02,1800,1200
B02,2026-02,900,720
B03,2026-02,,300
B04,2026-02,1300,780
C01,2026-03,2200,1430
C02,2026-03,1400,980
C03,2026-03,700,770
D01,2026-04,2600,1690
D02,2026-04,1700,1020
D03,2026-04,900,630
D04,2026-04,500,
"""

raw = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(RAW_CSV), dtype={"order_id": str, "month": str})
n_raw = len(raw)
print("=" * 60)
print("【模拟数据】原始订单明细行数 =", n_raw)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 规则 1：按 order_id 去重，保留首条
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
dup_mask = raw.duplicated(subset=["order_id"], keep="first")
dup_count = int(dup_mask.sum())
dup_ids = raw.loc[dup_mask, "order_id"].tolist()
print("重复数（按 order_id 去重删除的行数）= %d，被删除的 order_id = %s" % (dup_count, dup_ids))
dedup = raw.loc[~dup_mask].copy()

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 规则 2：revenue 或 cost 缺失的订单剔除（不用 0 冒充真实收入）
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
miss_mask = dedup["revenue"].isna() | dedup["cost"].isna()
miss_count = int(miss_mask.sum())
miss_ids = dedup.loc[miss_mask, "order_id"].tolist()
print("缺失数（revenue 或 cost 缺失被剔除的行数）= %d，被剔除的 order_id = %s" % (miss_count, miss_ids))
clean = dedup.loc[~miss_mask].copy()

# 规则 3：不剔除毛利为负的有效订单（显式保留）
clean["gross_profit"] = clean["revenue"] - clean["cost"]
neg = clean[clean["gross_profit"] < 0]
print("保留的负毛利有效订单数 = %d，order_id = %s" % (len(neg), neg["order_id"].tolist()))

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 输出列严格为 order_id,month,revenue,cost
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
clean = clean[["order_id", "month", "revenue", "cost"]].reset_index(drop=True)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 验收检查（规避陷阱：不重新硬编码原始数据，全部基于当前 DataFrame）
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
print("-" * 60)
print("验收检查：")
print("  clean.csv 行数 = %d （期望 15 - 1 - 2 = 12）" % len(clean))
print("  order_id 唯一性：nunique=%d, len=%d, 唯一=%s"
      % (clean["order_id"].nunique(), len(clean), clean["order_id"].nunique() == len(clean)))
print("  revenue 缺失数 = %d, cost 缺失数 = %d （期望均为 0）"
      % (clean["revenue"].isna().sum(), clean["cost"].isna().sum()))
c03 = clean[clean["order_id"] == "C03"]
print("  C03 是否保留 = %s，其 revenue=%s, cost=%s, 毛利=%s"
      % (not c03.empty,
         c03["revenue"].iloc[0] if not c03.empty else None,
         c03["cost"].iloc[0] if not c03.empty else None,
         (c03["revenue"].iloc[0] - c03["cost"].iloc[0]) if not c03.empty else None))
print("=" * 60)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 落盘
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
clean.to_csv("clean.csv", index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
print("已写出 clean.csv，共 %d 行。" % len(clean))

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
步骤 2/3：读取 clean.csv，按 month 汇总生成 monthly_summary.csv
数据说明：本流程使用【模拟订单数据】，不代表任何公司真实经营情况。
金额单位：元。
"""
import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.rcParams['font.sans-serif'] = ['Microsoft YaHei', 'SimHei', 'DejaVu Sans']
plt.rcParams['axes.unicode_minus'] = False

TOL = 1e-8
INPUT_FILE = "clean.csv"
OUTPUT_FILE = "monthly_summary.csv"

# ---------- 1. 读取前序产物 clean.csv（缺失则报错，禁止重造数据） ----------
if not os.path.exists(INPUT_FILE):
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"缺少约定输入文件：{INPUT_FILE}，本步骤不重造数据。")

clean = pd.read_csv(INPUT_FILE)
print("[输入] clean.csv 行数 =", len(clean), "| 列 =", list(clean.columns))

# 基本字段校验
required_cols = ["order_id", "month", "revenue", "cost"]
missing_cols = [c for c in required_cols if c not in clean.columns]
if missing_cols:
    raise ValueError(f"clean.csv 缺少必要列：{missing_cols}")

# 规避陷阱：确认 clean.csv 已无缺失（本步骤不擅自用 0 填充）
na_cnt = int(clean[["revenue", "cost"]].isna().sum().sum())
print("[检查] clean.csv 中 revenue/cost 缺失数 =", na_cnt, "（应为 0，缺失订单已在前序剔除）")
if na_cnt != 0:
    raise ValueError("clean.csv 仍存在 revenue/cost 缺失，违反前序清洗契约。")

# 规避陷阱：确认 clean.csv 已按 order_id 去重
dup_cnt = int(clean["order_id"].duplicated().sum())
print("[检查] clean.csv 中重复 order_id 数 =", dup_cnt, "（应为 0，重复订单已在前序去重）")
if dup_cnt != 0:
    raise ValueError("clean.csv 仍存在重复 order_id，违反前序清洗契约。")

# ---------- 2. 按 month 汇总（不复制原始数据重算，只读 clean.csv） ----------
grp = clean.groupby("month", as_index=False).agg(
    revenue=("revenue", "sum"),
    cost=("cost", "sum"),
    orders=("order_id", "count"),
)

# 规避陷阱：毛利 = 总收入 - 总成本；毛利率 = 毛利 / 总收入（不使用平均单笔毛利率）
grp["gross_profit"] = grp["revenue"] - grp["cost"]
grp["gross_margin"] = grp["gross_profit"] / grp["revenue"]

# 列名严格顺序
grp = grp[["month", "revenue", "cost", "gross_profit", "gross_margin", "orders"]]
grp = grp.sort_values("month").reset_index(drop=True)

# ---------- 3. 验收校验 ----------
# 3.1 列名精确匹配
expected_cols = ["month", "revenue", "cost", "gross_profit", "gross_margin", "orders"]
assert list(grp.columns) == expected_cols, f"列名不匹配：{list(grp.columns)}"
print("[校验] 列名精确匹配 =", list(grp.columns) == expected_cols)

# 3.2 总额与 clean.csv 一致（容差 1e-8）
rev_ok = abs(grp["revenue"].sum() - clean["revenue"].sum()) < TOL
cost_ok = abs(grp["cost"].sum() - clean["cost"].sum()) < TOL
print(f"[校验] revenue 合计一致 = {rev_ok} | summary={grp['revenue'].sum():.2f} vs clean={clean['revenue'].sum():.2f}")
print(f"[校验] cost    合计一致 = {cost_ok} | summary={grp['cost'].sum():.2f} vs clean={clean['cost'].sum():.2f}")
assert rev_ok and cost_ok, "月度汇总总额与 clean.csv 不一致"

# 3.3 orders 合计等于 clean.csv 行数
orders_ok = int(grp["orders"].sum()) == len(clean)
print(f"[校验] orders 合计 = {int(grp['orders'].sum())} == clean 行数 {len(clean)} -> {orders_ok}")
assert orders_ok, "orders 合计与 clean.csv 行数不一致"

# 3.4 逐月公式自洽
gp_ok = bool(np.all(np.abs(grp["gross_profit"] - (grp["revenue"] - grp["cost"])) < TOL))
gm_ok = bool(np.all(np.abs(grp["gross_margin"] - grp["gross_profit"] / grp["revenue"]) < TOL))
print(f"[校验] 逐月 gross_profit == revenue - cost -> {gp_ok}")
print(f"[校验] 逐月 gross_margin == gross_profit/revenue -> {gm_ok}")
assert gp_ok and gm_ok, "逐月毛利/毛利率公式不自洽"

# ---------- 4. 打印关键结果 ----------
print("\n[结果] monthly_summary（模拟数据，金额单位：元）")
print(grp.to_string(index=False))
print(f"\n[汇总] 4 个月总收入 = {grp['revenue'].sum():.2f} 元，"
      f"总成本 = {grp['cost'].sum():.2f} 元，"
      f"总毛利 = {grp['gross_profit'].sum():.2f} 元，"
      f"整体毛利率 = {grp['gross_profit'].sum()/grp['revenue'].sum():.4f}")

# ---------- 5. 落盘 ----------
grp.to_csv(OUTPUT_FILE, index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
print(f"\n[落盘] 已写出 {OUTPUT_FILE}，行数 = {len(grp)}")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 输入：模拟订单明细（内嵌，无外部依赖，不联网）
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
RAW_CSV = """order_id,month,revenue,cost

A03,2026-01,1500,900
A03,2026-01,1500,900

D01,2026-04,2600,1690
D02,2026-04,1700,1020

D04,2026-04,500,
"""

raw = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(RAW_CSV), dtype={"order_id": str, "month": str})
n_raw = len(raw)
print("=" * 60)
print("【模拟数据】原始订单明细行数 =", n_raw)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
dup_mask = raw.duplicated(subset=["order_id"], keep="first")

print("重复数（按 order_id 去重删除的行数）= %d，被删除的 order_id = %s" % (dup_count, dup_ids))
dedup = raw.loc[~dup_mask].copy()

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 规则 2：revenue 或 cost 缺失的订单剔除（不用 0 冒充真实收入）
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
miss_mask = dedup["revenue"].isna() | dedup["cost"].isna()
miss_count = int(miss_mask.sum())
miss_ids = dedup.loc[miss_mask, "order_id"].tolist()
print("缺失数（revenue 或 cost 缺失被剔除的行数）= %d，被剔除的 order_id = %s" % (miss_count, miss_ids))
clean = dedup.loc[~miss_mask].copy()

# 规则 3：不剔除毛利为负的有效订单（显式保留）
clean["gross_profit"] = clean["revenue"] - clean["cost"]
neg = clean[clean["gross_profit"] < 0]
print("保留的负毛利有效订单数 = %d，order_id = %s" % (len(neg), neg["order_id"].tolist()))

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 输出列严格为 order_id,month,revenue,cost
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
clean = clean[["order_id", "month", "revenue", "cost"]].reset_index(drop=True)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 验收检查（规避陷阱：不重新硬编码原始数据，全部基于当前 DataFrame）
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
print("-" * 60)
print("验收检查：")
print("  clean.csv 行数 = %d （期望 15 - 1 - 2 = 12）" % len(clean))
print("  order_id 唯一性：nunique=%d, len=%d, 唯一=%s"
      % (clean["order_id"].nunique(), len(clean), clean["order_id"].nunique() == len(clean)))
print("  revenue 缺失数 = %d, cost 缺失数 = %d （期望均为 0）"
      % (clean["revenue"].isna().sum(), clean["cost"].isna().sum()))
c03 = clean[clean["order_id"] == "C03"]
print("  C03 是否保留 = %s，其 revenue=%s, cost=%s, 毛利=%s"
      % (not c03.empty,
         c03["revenue"].iloc[0] if not c03.empty else None,
         c03["cost"].iloc[0] if not c03.empty else None,
         (c03["revenue"].iloc[0] - c03["cost"].iloc[0]) if not c03.empty else None))
print("=" * 60)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 落盘
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
clean.to_csv("clean.csv", index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
print("已写出 clean.csv，共 %d 行。" % len(clean))

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
步骤 2/3：读取 clean.csv，按 month 汇总生成 monthly_summary.csv
数据说明：本流程使用【模拟订单数据】，不代表任何公司真实经营情况。
金额单位：元。
"""
import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.rcParams['font.sans-serif'] = ['Microsoft YaHei', 'SimHei', 'DejaVu Sans']
plt.rcParams['axes.unicode_minus'] = False

TOL = 1e-8
INPUT_FILE = "clean.csv"
OUTPUT_FILE = "monthly_summary.csv"

# ---------- 1. 读取前序产物 clean.csv（缺失则报错，禁止重造数据） ----------
if not os.path.exists(INPUT_FILE):
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"缺少约定输入文件：{INPUT_FILE}，本步骤不重造数据。")

clean = pd.read_csv(INPUT_FILE)
print("[输入] clean.csv 行数 =", len(clean), "| 列 =", list(clean.columns))

# 基本字段校验
required_cols = ["order_id", "month", "revenue", "cost"]
missing_cols = [c for c in required_cols if c not in clean.columns]
if missing_cols:
    raise ValueError(f"clean.csv 缺少必要列：{missing_cols}")

# 规避陷阱：确认 clean.csv 已无缺失（本步骤不擅自用 0 填充）
na_cnt = int(clean[["revenue", "cost"]].isna().sum().sum())
print("[检查] clean.csv 中 revenue/cost 缺失数 =", na_cnt, "（应为 0，缺失订单已在前序剔除）")
if na_cnt != 0:
    raise ValueError("clean.csv 仍存在 revenue/cost 缺失，违反前序清洗契约。")

# 规避陷阱：确认 clean.csv 已按 order_id 去重
dup_cnt = int(clean["order_id"].duplicated().sum())
print("[检查] clean.csv 中重复 order_id 数 =", dup_cnt, "（应为 0，重复订单已在前序去重）")
if dup_cnt != 0:
    raise ValueError("clean.csv 仍存在重复 order_id，违反前序清洗契约。")

# ---------- 2. 按 month 汇总（不复制原始数据重算，只读 clean.csv） ----------
grp = clean.groupby("month", as_index=False).agg(
    revenue=("revenue", "sum"),
    cost=("cost", "sum"),
    orders=("order_id", "count"),
)

# 规避陷阱：毛利 = 总收入 - 总成本；毛利率 = 毛利 / 总收入（不使用平均单笔毛利率）
grp["gross_profit"] = grp["revenue"] - grp["cost"]
grp["gross_margin"] = grp["gross_profit"] / grp["revenue"]

# 列名严格顺序
grp = grp[["month", "revenue", "cost", "gross_profit", "gross_margin", "orders"]]
grp = grp.sort_values("month").reset_index(drop=True)

# ---------- 3. 验收校验 ----------
# 3.1 列名精确匹配
expected_cols = ["month", "revenue", "cost", "gross_profit", "gross_margin", "orders"]
assert list(grp.columns) == expected_cols, f"列名不匹配：{list(grp.columns)}"
print("[校验] 列名精确匹配 =", list(grp.columns) == expected_cols)

# 3.2 总额与 clean.csv 一致（容差 1e-8）
rev_ok = abs(grp["revenue"].sum() - clean["revenue"].sum()) < TOL
cost_ok = abs(grp["cost"].sum() - clean["cost"].sum()) < TOL
print(f"[校验] revenue 合计一致 = {rev_ok} | summary={grp['revenue'].sum():.2f} vs clean={clean['revenue'].sum():.2f}")
print(f"[校验] cost    合计一致 = {cost_ok} | summary={grp['cost'].sum():.2f} vs clean={clean['cost'].sum():.2f}")
assert rev_ok and cost_ok, "月度汇总总额与 clean.csv 不一致"

# 3.3 orders 合计等于 clean.csv 行数
orders_ok = int(grp["orders"].sum()) == len(clean)
print(f"[校验] orders 合计 = {int(grp['orders'].sum())} == clean 行数 {len(clean)} -> {orders_ok}")
assert orders_ok, "orders 合计与 clean.csv 行数不一致"

# 3.4 逐月公式自洽
gp_ok = bool(np.all(np.abs(grp["gross_profit"] - (grp["revenue"] - grp["cost"])) < TOL))
gm_ok = bool(np.all(np.abs(grp["gross_margin"] - grp["gross_profit"] / grp["revenue"]) < TOL))
print(f"[校验] 逐月 gross_profit == revenue - cost -> {gp_ok}")
print(f"[校验] 逐月 gross_margin == gross_profit/revenue -> {gm_ok}")
assert gp_ok and gm_ok, "逐月毛利/毛利率公式不自洽"

# ---------- 4. 打印关键结果 ----------
print("\n[结果] monthly_summary（模拟数据，金额单位：元）")
print(grp.to_string(index=False))
print(f"\n[汇总] 4 个月总收入 = {grp['revenue'].sum():.2f} 元，"
      f"总成本 = {grp['cost'].sum():.2f} 元，"
      f"总毛利 = {grp['gross_profit'].sum():.2f} 元，"
      f"整体毛利率 = {grp['gross_profit'].sum()/grp['revenue'].sum():.4f}")

# ---------- 5. 落盘 ----------
grp.to_csv(OUTPUT_FILE, index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
print(f"\n[落盘] 已写出 {OUTPUT_FILE}，行数 = {len(grp)}")
